module piso_shift_register (
    input [3:0] data,
    input load,
    input clk,
    output reg serial_out
);
    reg [3:0] shift_reg;
    integer count;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            shift_reg <= data; // Load data into shift register
            count <= 0; // Reset count when loading new data
        end else if (count < 4) begin
            serial_out <= shift_reg[3]; // Output the highest bit
            shift_reg <= {shift_reg[2:0], 1'b0}; // Shift left

        end
    end
endmodule

    input clk,
    input reset,
    input start_read,
    input start_write,
    output reg [1:0] state // 00: IDLE, 01: READ, 10: WRITE, 11: ERROR
);
    parameter IDLE = 2'b00, READ = 2'b01, WRITE = 2'b10, ERROR = 2'b11;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= IDLE;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (start_read) state <= READ;
                    else if (start_write) state <= WRITE;

                READ: begin
                    // Simulate reading operation
                    state <= IDLE; // Transition back to IDLE after read
                end
                WRITE: begin
                    // Simulate writing operation

description:

    input [7:0] A,
    input [7:0] B,
    input [2:0] ALUControl,
    output reg [7:0] Result,
    output reg Overflow
);
    
    always @(*) begin
        Overflow = 0; // Default overflow
        case (ALUControl)
            3'b000: begin // ADD
                {Overflow, Result} = A + B;
            end
            3'b001: begin // SUBTRACT
                {Overflow, Result} = A - B;
            end
            3'b010: begin // AND
                Result = A & B;
            end
            3'b011: begin // OR
                Result = A | B;
            end
            3'b100: begin // XOR
                Result = A ^ B;
            end
            3'b101: begin // NAND
                Result = ~(A & B);
            end
            3'b110: begin // NOR
                Result = ~(A | B);
            end
            3'b111: begin // NOT
                Result = ~A;
            end
            default: begin
                Result = 8'b00000000;
            end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

                TRANSMIT: begin
                    if (~rx_tx_signal)

    end
